narrative:
Good morning, Damien. Here is Gamma as of yesterday's billing run.

**Revenue** — the FY2026 Q3 forecast is GBP 663.9M against the GBP 668.6M budget (−GBP 4.7M). About 88% is recurring.

**Gross margin** — 53.7% against 54.1% in the budget. Legacy voice decline cost GBP 9.8M of GP YTD; PhoneLine+ replaced GBP 6.1M.

**Adjusted EBITDA** — GBP 141.6M forecast against GBP 145.8M budget (21.3%).

**Revenue at risk** — GBP 18.6M of recurring revenue flagged by the churn model; 7 partners hold 41%.

**Revenue assurance** — the September billing run shows 1,840 provisioned-but-unbilled assets (about GBP 3.9M a year of leakage).

**Germany** — cost synergies GBP 2.1M behind plan YTD.

**Pending your decision:** 4 items — partner retention sprint, billing-run control, Openreach pass-through and the fourth German platform migration.

signals.title: Recommended cash offer from Epiris (Bradbury Bidco)
signals.source: Gamma Communications plc — Rule 2.7 announcement, 1 September 2026
signals.excerpt: 1,120 pence per share; equity value about £1.015bn and enterprise value about £1.079bn. Completion expected in H1 2027, subject to approvals.

signals.title: £18.6M recurring revenue at risk — 7 partners hold 41%
signals.source: Gamma churn model on Snowflake (SDP model)
signals.excerpt: Churn classifier scored every account from billing-run, order and support signals; drivers are legacy lines with no migration order, Operator Connect evaluation and billing disputes.

signals.title: Billing leakage £3.9M a year (0.6% of revenue)
signals.excerpt: 1,840 provisioned-but-unbilled assets in the September billing run, 6,300 lines on a superseded price list, CDR rating errors after the March rate-table update.
